legal_terms_s2_body1: verifykm provides Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) lookup and vehicle history report services. Reports are compiled from independent third-party sources, which may include auction marketplaces, insurance and claims databases, odometer registries, theft records, listing platforms, and other commercial data providers. verifykm aggregates and presents information. We do not create primary vehicle records, and we do not inspect vehicles.
legal_terms_s2_body2: Descriptions on our website and in marketing materials of categories that a report may contain (for example mileage history, accident indicators, salvage or title-related flags, theft records, ownership history, specifications, or photographs) describe the scope of the Service when such information exists in the sources we query. They are not a guarantee that every category, field, or record will be available for every VIN.
legal_terms_s2_body3: Delivery may be immediate or delayed. If data is not available for automatic fulfillment at the time of purchase, we may place the order in a manual-fulfillment queue. When the report is ready, we deliver it to your account and may notify you by email at the address associated with your account.
legal_terms_s3_body: To purchase and access reports you must register an account. You may register with email and password or through supported third-party sign-in providers (currently Google and Facebook). You must provide accurate registration information, including country or nationality where requested. You are responsible for safeguarding your credentials and for all activity under your account. Notify us promptly at {{email}} if you suspect unauthorized access.
legal_terms_s4_body1: You may purchase individual vehicle reports and, where offered, prepaid credit packs. Payment may be processed through PayPal and/or POK (or other processors we enable and display at checkout). We do not store full payment card numbers. Prices are those shown at checkout at the time of purchase. Credits, where purchased or granted, may be redeemed for reports according to the rules displayed in the Service; unused credits do not expire unless we state otherwise at the time of purchase or grant.
legal_terms_s4_refund_body: A report that is generated and made available in your account, including a report with limited, partial, or missing sections because third-party sources held little or no data for that VIN, constitutes fulfillment of that purchase. We do not refund solely because a report does not meet your expectations or because fields are empty where providers had no data. If fulfillment fails for reasons attributable to us (for example a technical failure that prevents delivery of any report), we may restore a credit to your account, grant a complimentary credit, and/or process a monetary refund upon request. Monetary refunds are handled manually; contact {{email}}. Where we offer a credit or refund for a specific no-data or failure case, the remedy we provide for that case is your exclusive remedy for that purchase, to the extent permitted by law.
legal_terms_s5_title: 5. Accuracy, Completeness, and Availability of Information
legal_terms_s5_body0: verifykm does not create vehicle history records. We collect and present data supplied by independent third parties. We are not responsible for the accuracy, authenticity, or completeness of information supplied by those sources.
legal_terms_s5_body1: Vehicle history data is outside verifykm's control. We do not warrant that any report is complete, accurate, current, or error-free. Reports are provided "as is" and "as available".
legal_terms_s5_body2: Data availability varies by vehicle. A report may include only a subset of categories shown in marketing or sample reports. Limited or missing information may result from factors including, without limitation:
legal_terms_s5_li1: Whether the vehicle's history was reported to insurers, auctions, marketplaces, or government agencies
legal_terms_s5_li2: Country or region of registration, export, import, or prior use
legal_terms_s5_li3: Vehicle age, mileage, or periods before digital record-keeping
legal_terms_s5_li4: Delays, gaps, or inconsistencies in third-party databases
legal_terms_s5_li5: Provider coverage limits, licensing restrictions, or source-specific rules
legal_terms_s5_li6: Privacy laws or data-retention policies that limit disclosure
legal_terms_s5_body3: The absence of a negative record (for example no listed accident, salvage flag, or theft record) does not mean that no such event occurred. A flagged record reflects what a source reported at a point in time and may require independent verification.
legal_terms_s5_body4: Reports are for informational purposes only. They are not legal, mechanical, financial, or professional advice. Do not rely on a verifykm report as the sole basis for a purchase, sale, financing, insurance, or safety decision. Obtain an independent physical inspection, professional evaluation, and review of official documents before any transaction.

legal_privacy_intro: This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, share, and retain personal data when you use verifykm.com. It applies together with our Terms of Service.
legal_privacy_s1_account_body: Email address; name (optional); country or nationality; optional phone number (prefix and national number); password stored as a one-way hash when you set a password; identifiers linked to Google or Facebook if you sign in with those providers; account status and credit balance.
legal_privacy_s1_usage_body: VINs you look up; report and lookup timestamps and status; payment records (amount, currency, method, and processor references such as PayPal or POK transaction identifiers, we do not store full card numbers); coupon or credit redemptions; IP address and related signals used for security and abuse prevention.
legal_privacy_s1_technical_body: Browser and device information, language preference (including from the URL), pages visited, and similar technical logs. If we enable analytics or advertising tags in our admin settings (for example Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity, or Meta Pixel), those tools may collect identifiers and usage data as described by their providers.
legal_privacy_s2_li1: Create and manage your account and authenticate you
legal_privacy_s2_li2: Process payments and credit purchases or redemptions
legal_privacy_s2_li3: Generate, store, and deliver vehicle history reports (including delayed / manual fulfillment)
legal_privacy_s2_li4: Detect and prevent fraud, abuse, and security incidents
legal_privacy_s2_li5: Operate, maintain, and improve the Service
legal_privacy_s2_li6: Send transactional emails (for example receipts, report-ready notices, password and security messages)
legal_privacy_s2_li7: Measure site usage and, when enabled, support marketing measurement via configured analytics or advertising tags
legal_privacy_s2_footer: We do not sell your personal data. We do not use your password or payment card PAN for advertising. Marketing or advertising technologies run only when we configure them in the Service and as described in this Policy.
legal_privacy_s3_intro: We share personal data only as needed to operate the Service:
legal_privacy_s3_auth: Hosting and authentication, Account credentials for email/password users are processed on our systems. Passwords are stored as one-way hashes and are not transmitted in plain text after login.
legal_privacy_s3_oauth: Google and Facebook, If you choose social sign-in, those providers authenticate you and share limited profile data (such as name, email, and provider user id) with us according to your settings with them.
legal_privacy_s3_recaptcha: reCAPTCHA, We may use Google reCAPTCHA on registration and login to reduce automated abuse. Google may process technical data under its own terms and privacy policy.
legal_privacy_s3_paypal: PayPal, Payment processing for supported PayPal checkout methods. Card data entered on PayPal is handled by PayPal; we receive payment status and reference identifiers.
legal_privacy_s3_pok: POK, Card payment processing where offered at checkout. Card data is handled by POK; we receive payment status and reference identifiers.
legal_privacy_s3_providers: Vehicle data providers, We send the VIN (not your name or email) to providers used to build reports. Returned content depends on what those providers hold for that VIN.
legal_privacy_s3_email: Email delivery, Transactional messages are sent through our configured email infrastructure to the address on your account.
legal_privacy_s3_analytics: Analytics and advertising vendors, If enabled in our settings, tools such as Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity, and/or Meta Pixel may receive technical and usage data as configured.
legal_privacy_s3_footer: Vehicle history content in reports comes from third-party sources. Availability and completeness vary by vehicle and jurisdiction. This Policy governs personal data we process; it does not expand or guarantee the scope of vehicle history data from external providers.
legal_privacy_s4_body1: When you request a report, we query third-party sources and/or use catalogued data on your behalf. Categories we may present, mileage readings, accident-related records, salvage or title-related indicators, theft flags, ownership history, specifications, photographs, or other fields, depend on what those sources make available for the VIN.
legal_privacy_s4_body2: Some vehicles have extensive records; others have limited or no records in the databases we access. Marketing and sample reports describe typical capabilities when data exists. They are not a representation that every data point will be present for every vehicle. Report content is subject to the coverage, accuracy, and update practices of independent providers.
legal_privacy_s5_body: We retain account data while your account remains open and as needed for legal, accounting, and dispute purposes. VIN lookup and report records linked to your account are retained so you can re-access purchases and so we can provide support, until you ask us to delete them (where feasible) or we delete the account. Shared catalog entries for a VIN may remain after an individual account is removed, because they are not personal to one user. There is no automated self-service account deletion in the product today; to request erasure of personal data, email {{email}}. We will respond within a reasonable period and aim to do so within 30 days where applicable law requires.

legal_cookie_essential_desc: Authentication and session cookies required to keep you signed in and to operate secure requests. These are necessary for the Service to function.
legal_cookie_storage_desc: Theme preference (light/dark) is stored in your browser's local storage. Language is selected via the URL path (for example /en/…). These are not used to build vehicle history reports.
legal_cookie_analytics_desc: If we enable Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity, Meta Pixel, or similar tools in our admin settings, those vendors may set cookies or use similar identifiers to measure traffic or advertising performance. They run only when configured; we do not provide a separate in-product cookie preference panel today.
